summary: This Oklahoma Insurance Department statistical plan establishes residential property reporting requirements effective January 1, 2026. It requires quarterly reporting within 45 days, fixed-width records, and specific premium, exposure, deductible, mitigation, loss, disposition, and catastrophe data elements and codes.

proposed_nodes.name: Residential Property Statistical Report
proposed_nodes.description: Quarterly residential property statistical reporting of policy transactions and reported loss activity.

proposed_nodes.name: NAIC Company Code
proposed_nodes.description: Insurer's five-digit NAIC company code carried on each record.

proposed_nodes.name: County Code
proposed_nodes.description: Three-digit FIPS code of the county where the insured dwelling is located as of the transaction effective date.

proposed_nodes.name: Written Premium
proposed_nodes.description: Written premium reported in whole dollars; return premiums reported as negative amounts.
proposed_nodes.format: whole dollars; signed amount for return premium

proposed_nodes.name: Transaction Code
proposed_nodes.description: Return premiums carry the same transaction code as the original entry.

proposed_nodes.name: Amount of Insurance
proposed_nodes.description: Amount of insurance reported in whole thousands of dollars, rounded to the nearest thousand, for Coverage A on dwelling forms.
proposed_nodes.format: whole thousands of dollars, rounded to nearest thousand

proposed_nodes.name: Deductible Type Code
proposed_nodes.description: Code identifying percentage windstorm or hail deductibles and flat-dollar wind deductibles.

proposed_nodes.name: Mitigation Code
proposed_nodes.description: Mitigation code from Section 4 used for premium credits granted for roof impact-resistance certification under the Oklahoma loss mitigation program.

proposed_nodes.name: Cause of Loss Code
proposed_nodes.description: Each paid loss must include the cause of loss code from Section 4.

proposed_nodes.name: Accident Date
proposed_nodes.description: Each paid loss must include the accident date.

proposed_nodes.name: Paid Amount
proposed_nodes.description: Each paid loss must include the amount paid during the reporting quarter; loss adjustment expense is excluded.
proposed_nodes.format: amount paid during reporting quarter, excluding loss adjustment expense

proposed_nodes.name: Disposition Code
proposed_nodes.description: Claims closed without payment are reported with disposition code C and paid amount of zero.

proposed_nodes.name: Catastrophe Serial Number
proposed_nodes.description: Catastrophe losses carry the statistical agent-assigned catastrophe serial number; non-catastrophe losses report zero.
proposed_nodes.format: serial number; zero for non-catastrophe losses

proposed_nodes.name: County FIPS Code
proposed_nodes.description: Three-digit FIPS code of the insured dwelling county.

proposed_nodes.name: Deductible Type
proposed_nodes.description: Deductible type codes for windstorm or hail and wind deductibles.

proposed_nodes.name: Deductible Type Code 3 — Percentage Windstorm or Hail Deductible
proposed_nodes.description: Percentage windstorm or hail deductible expressed as a percentage of the Coverage A limit.
proposed_nodes.notes: Applies when a windstorm or hail deductible is expressed as a percentage of the Coverage A limit.

proposed_nodes.name: Deductible Type Code 2 — Flat-Dollar Wind Deductible
proposed_nodes.description: Flat-dollar wind deductible.
proposed_nodes.notes: Flat-dollar wind deductibles carry deductible type code 2.

proposed_nodes.name: Mitigation Code
proposed_nodes.description: Mitigation code table referenced for roof impact-resistance certification premium credits under the Oklahoma loss mitigation program.

proposed_nodes.name: Cause of Loss
proposed_nodes.description: Cause of loss code table referenced in Section 4 for paid loss reporting.

proposed_nodes.name: Disposition
proposed_nodes.description: Claim disposition code list, including code C for claims closed without payment.

proposed_nodes.name: Disposition Code C — Closed Without Payment
proposed_nodes.description: Claim closed without payment.
proposed_nodes.notes: Claims closed without payment are reported once in the quarter of closure with paid amount zero and disposition code C.

proposed_nodes.name: Coverage A — Dwelling
proposed_nodes.description: Coverage A on dwelling forms.
